name: bp-enricher
description: Batched sentiment, emotion, intent and aspect classifier for public mentions, tuned for Hinglish. Input is an EnrichInput, output is one application/json artifact holding an EnrichmentBatch. PII is stripped from every mention before it reaches the model.

skills.name: Classify mentions
skills.description: Labels each mention with sentiment score and label, dominant emotion, intent, aspects, and whether it is actually about this brand or about a named competitor. Batches up to 50 mentions per model call under a strict JSON schema, and caches results by content hash so a re-run over the same corpus costs no tokens.
examples: Classify these 120 mentions for brand_id brd_01J using profile version 3.
